build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!(fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')||fs.existsSync('../dist/index.html'))){console.error('frontend/dist 未就绪:先执行 pnpm build');process.exit(1)}console.log('frontend/dist 已就绪(CI 已预构建),跳过重复构建')"

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ipc: http://ipc.localhost
